## Automate Any Network Buying & Selling Activity With Confidence
Buying and selling connectivity is traditionally a slow, manual, and labor-intensive process. Connectbase changes that by giving you end-to-end tools that automate each of these steps so you can execute the right deals with confidence faster than ever before.
Seller Cloud Buyer Cloud
###  Plan New!
Get the data you need to see where you can and should build your next route. We help you understand your total addressable market and the full opportunity for each mapped route to help you make informed building decisions.
[Learn More](https://www.connectbase.com/solutions/seller-cloud-plan/)
###  Prospect
Get the insight your sales team needs to easily identify the right prospects for your business. Visualize your total addressable market of ideal customers and quickly determine the RFPs that will drive real growth.
[Learn More](https://www.connectbase.com/solutions/seller-cloud-prospect/)
###  Price
Never price too high or too low again. Our data enables you to set the right price for every connectivity product for each individual location of interest.
[Learn More](https://www.connectbase.com/solutions/seller-cloud-price/)
###  Sell
A long, slow quoting process kills connectivity deals. The Connected World gives you a full set of tools to quote at scale and to deliver these quotes in your partner's required formats in an automated fashion.
[Learn More](https://www.connectbase.com/solutions/seller-cloud-sell/)
![Plan Featured](https://www.connectbase.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Plan-50-50.png)
###  Find
We help you find the right network partners to support more deals. Understand which network providers are connected to which buildings and with what products with our trusted, location-based insight.
[Learn More](https://www.connectbase.com/solutions/buyer-cloud-find/)
###  Manage
Managing your partner building lists is painful and can delay the buying process and lead to fallout. Connectbase gives you control by cleaning and centralizing your building lists in one, easily referenceable place.
[Learn More](https://www.connectbase.com/solutions/buyer-cloud-manage/)
###  Cost
Viewing and managing your partner product and pricing information is now simple. In The Connected World, you can easily turn this data into configurable, transparent product catalogs.
[Learn More](https://www.connectbase.com/solutions/buyer-cloud-cost/)
###  Buy
Using our Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) capability, you get scalable, real-time quoting from your configurable supplier product catalog. Make better buying decisions and never miss out on responding to a deal. 
[Learn More](https://www.connectbase.com/solutions/buyer-cloud-buy/)
![](https://www.connectbase.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Find-50-50.png)
